_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#002.src: ... Achara... I do not believe I can ever atone for what I have done to you. An apology simply isn't enough.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#002.dst: ... Achara... 내가 너한테 한 짓을 속죄할 수 있을 것 같지 않아. 사과로는 턱없이 부족해.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#002.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#003.src: As infuriating as what you did was, you were following orders... I had every right to be angry, but to try and take your life was ten steps too far.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#003.dst: 네가 한 일에 화가 났던 건 맞지만, 넌 명령을 따랐을 뿐이야... 화낼 권리는 있었어도, 네 목숨을 빼앗으려 한 건 너무 지나쳤어.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#003.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#004.src: Even though it is not enough, I will say I am sorry for the pain I caused you. The Guardian was right, in the end.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#004.dst: 부족하겠지만 그래도 말할게. 네게 준 고통, 정말 미안해. 결국 수호자님 말씀이 옳았어.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#004.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#005.src: Without you carrying out Orphion's will, we would not be here. You truly are necessary in this, and I believe I have finally made peace with that.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#005.dst: 네가 Orphion의 뜻을 따르지 않았다면 우린 여기까지 못 왔을 거야. 넌 정말 꼭 필요한 존재야. 이제야 그걸 받아들인 것 같아.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#005.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#006.src: It has been a long time since I had a partner willing to help me in this way. I was unused to it, I suppose... Still.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#006.dst: 이렇게 기꺼이 도와주는 동료는 정말 오랜만이야. 익숙하지 않았나 봐... 그래도.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#006.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#007.src: If you'll be willing to aid me, it would be a great relief. It has been a thousand years since I entered the Realm of Light...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#007.dst: 네가 도와준다면 정말 든든할 거야. 내가 빛의 영역에 들어간 지 벌써 천 년이 지났어...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#007.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#008.src: I can only hope things have not changed much. I remember how it was, right down to the last petal...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#008.dst: 많이 변하지 않았기만 바랄 뿐이야. 그곳 모습은 마지막 꽃잎 하나까지 기억하거든...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#008.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#009.src: Walk towards the portal with Lari.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#010.src: Wait a moment, {u}. I have one more thing I would like to say before we enter.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#010.dst: 잠깐만, {u}. 들어가기 전에 하나 더 할 말이 있어.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#010.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#011.src: I... I need to thank you. For helping, as you have. For staying by me as you have. There was one other before you like that...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#011.dst: 나... 너한테 고마워. 이렇게 도와줘서. 이렇게 내 곁에 있어 줘서. 너 전에도 그런 사람이 딱 한 명 있었어...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#011.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#012.src: I promise that you will not meet the same fate as him. I will fight with you to the bitter end, achara.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#012.dst: 넌 그 사람과 같은 운명을 맞지 않을 거야, 약속해. 끝까지 너와 함께 싸울게, achara.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#012.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#013.src: It's time, then. To visit Orphion.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#013.dst: 그럼 때가 됐어. Orphion을 만나러 가자.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#013.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#014.src: Jump into the portal after Lari.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#015.src: Talk to Lari at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] in the Realm of Light.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#016.src: Welcome to the Realm of Light then, {u}. Once you've re-oriented yourself, come over here.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#016.dst: 그럼 빛의 영역에 온 걸 환영해, {u}. 정신 좀 차리면 이쪽으로 와.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#016.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#017.src: It's so much smaller than it used to be! There used to be many more landmasses, all connected to each other...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#017.dst: 예전보다 훨씬 작아졌어! 전엔 땅덩어리가 훨씬 많았고, 전부 서로 이어져 있었는데...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#017.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#018.src: I feel... I feel everything in here. With Orphion's light, I can tap into the very core of the realm.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#018.dst: 느껴져... 여기 모든 게 느껴져. Orphion의 빛으로 이 영역의 핵심에 닿을 수 있어.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#018.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#019.src: And I can feel disturbances. There are dark creatures here, where there should be none!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#019.dst: 그리고 이상한 기운도 느껴져. 있어선 안 될 어둠의 생물들이 여기 있어!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#019.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#020.src: I mean, even look at this creature. The light emanating from it is-
The Realm of Light (Quest)#020.dst: 그러니까, 이 생물만 봐도 그래. 이 녀석에게서 나오는 빛이-
The Realm of Light (Quest)#020.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#021.src: Wait. Wh... Why is it attacking you!?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#021.dst: 잠깐. 뭐... 왜 널 공격하는 거야!?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#021.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#022.src: Its mind was addled by darkness. Poor thing was terrified... Nothing for it though.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#022.dst: 어둠에 정신이 흐려졌던 거야. 불쌍하게도 겁에 질렸었어... 어쩔 수 없었지만.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#022.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#023.src: I suppose your more ruthless nature is a good thing, in this case. We each will need to fight, if this is as widespread as it feels.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#023.dst: 이번엔 네 냉정한 성격이 오히려 다행인 것 같아. 느껴지는 만큼 퍼져 있다면 우리 둘 다 싸워야 할 테니까.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#023.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#024.src: I'll have to prepare myself for that... Being willing to take action will not make it any easier on my conscience.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#024.dst: 마음의 준비를 해야겠어... 행동할 각오를 한다고 양심이 편해지는 건 아니니까.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#024.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#025.src: But I will set that aside, until the day this all becomes a memory. We'll both need to seek the Nexus of Light, Orphion's home. Follow me!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#025.dst: 하지만 이 모든 게 추억이 되는 날까진 접어 둘게. 우린 Orphion의 거처, 빛의 넥서스를 찾아야 해. 따라와!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#025.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#026.src: Follow Lari to Orphion's Nexus of Light at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Realm of Light (Quest)#026.dst: Lari를 따라 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 오르피온의 빛의 넥서스로 가세요

The Realm of Light (Quest)#027.src: I should have expected this. With the connections severed, of course the bridge to the Nexus would be gone.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#027.dst: 이럴 줄 알았어야 했는데. 연결이 끊겼으니 넥서스로 가는 다리도 당연히 사라졌겠지.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#027.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#028.src: This must be because of that horrid parasite... The Guardian of the Forest informed me of the situation afterwards.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#028.dst: 분명 그 끔찍한 기생체 탓이야... 숲의 수호자님이 나중에 상황을 알려 주셨어.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#028.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#029.src: The gap may be too far for me to carry you over... Is there a way I can bypass this, I wonder?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#029.dst: 너무 멀어서 널 안고 건너긴 힘들 것 같아... 우회할 방법이 없을까?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#029.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#030.src: Perhaps I can try to bridge the gap myself. Let's see if this will work.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#030.dst: 내가 직접 틈을 이어 볼까. 되는지 보자.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#030.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#032.src: ...hm. That ought to have worked! Is the Nexus too far to reach?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#032.dst: ...흠. 됐어야 하는데! 넥서스가 너무 먼 건가?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#032.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#033.src: There has to be some way over... Maybe the direct method is- Hm? Another creature?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#033.dst: 건너갈 방법이 있을 거야... 어쩌면 정면으로- 응? 또 다른 생물?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#033.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#034.src: This one doesn't seem hostile, {u}... I'll try and talk with it.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#034.dst: 이 녀석은 적대적이지 않은 것 같아, {u}... 말을 걸어 볼게.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#034.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#035.src: Its mind is whole, but it's wary of your presence. You should stay back, just in case.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#035.dst: 정신은 멀쩡한데 널 경계하고 있어. 혹시 모르니 뒤로 물러나 있어.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#035.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#036.src: So tell me, achara. What is it you sought me for?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#036.dst: 그럼 말해 봐, achara. 날 찾아온 이유가 뭐야?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#036.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#037.src: Ahh, I see. You wish to see your master once more as well...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#037.dst: 아아, 그렇구나. 너도 네 주인을 다시 보고 싶은 거구나...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#037.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#038.src: The monoliths? Are they what's severed the connections?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#038.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#039.src: Ahh, I understand. I assure you, we will fix this!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#039.dst: 아아, 알겠어. 약속할게, 우리가 고칠 거야!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#039.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#040.src: It said that the connections to the rest of the realm were severed intentionally by Orphion, in order to protect them.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#040.dst: 영역의 다른 곳과의 연결은 Orphion이 그곳들을 지키려고 일부러 끊은 거래.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#040.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#041.src: Two monoliths on this landmass controlled the connections, and they are being drained of their light- As such, they closed the bridges.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#041.dst: 이 땅에 있는 모놀리스 두 개가 연결을 조종하는데, 빛이 빠져나가고 있대- 그래서 다리를 닫은 거고.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#041.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#042.src: The light is still there- But it must be drawn back out. We have our task ahead of us now, achara. We need to go to the first monolith. Follow me!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#042.dst: 빛은 아직 남아 있어- 다만 다시 끌어내야 해. 이제 할 일이 생겼어, achara. 첫 번째 모놀리스로 가야 해. 따라와!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#042.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#043.src: Search for the monolith Lari was talking about at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Realm of Light (Quest)#044.src: I never knew the monoliths kept the realm together as they did. You can see that it is inactive, yes?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#044.dst: 모놀리스가 이렇게 영역을 붙들고 있는 줄은 몰랐어. 멈춰 있는 거 보이지?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#044.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#045.src: There should be bright bands of color going along it, and light pouring from it. This is where we play our roles, {u}!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#045.dst: 원래는 밝은 색띠가 둘러져 있고 빛이 쏟아져 나와야 해. 이제 우리가 나설 차례야, {u}!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#045.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#046.src: It may be getting drained, but there is certainly still light within it, and if that parasite is battling Orphion we should be able to recharge it.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#046.dst: 빛이 빠져나가고 있긴 해도 안에 분명 남아 있어. 그 기생체가 Orphion과 싸우는 중이라면 다시 채울 수 있을 거야.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#046.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#047.src: I'll tap into the monolith... You'll need to enter it, and find its core. I'll send a part of Orphion's light with you to activate it once you do.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#047.dst: 내가 모놀리스와 연결할게... 넌 안으로 들어가서 핵을 찾아. 찾으면 Orphion의 빛 일부를 보내서 활성화할게.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#047.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#049.src: The damage here is minor- Nothing that can't be fixed, thankfully.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#049.dst: 여기 손상은 가벼워- 다행히 못 고칠 정도는 아니야.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#049.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#050.src: Its aura is lowered- Now your soul must enter. I will keep you safe, {u}.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#050.dst: 기운이 약해졌어- 이제 네 영혼이 들어가야 해. 내가 지켜 줄게, {u}.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#050.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#051.src: Allow my magic to open your senses... Good luck, achara.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#051.dst: 내 마법으로 감각을 열어 줄게... 행운을 빌어, achara.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#051.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#053.src: Find a way to fill the monolith with light.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#054.src: Follow Lari to the next monolith at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Realm of Light (Quest)#055.src: Welcome back, {u}. I had few troubles dealing with the creatures trying to get close. Did you have issues inside?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#055.dst: 돌아왔구나, {u}. 다가오려는 생물들은 별로 어렵지 않게 처리했어. 안에서 문제는 없었어?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#055.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#056.src: The light is starting to pulse out from the monolith again, so I would say you've succeeded. I suppose we do make a decent team?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#056.dst: 모놀리스에서 빛이 다시 고동치기 시작했으니 성공한 것 같아. 우리 꽤 괜찮은 팀인가 봐?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#056.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#057.src: Look! The colours are returning to the monolith! It's definitely reactivated. I'll run ahead and get to the other monolith.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#057.dst: 봐! 모놀리스에 색이 돌아오고 있어! 확실히 다시 작동해. 먼저 다른 모놀리스로 달려갈게.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#057.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#058.src: Follow the path! The way there is up the big cliff where we first entered the Realm.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#058.dst: 길을 따라와! 우리가 처음 영역에 들어온 큰 절벽 위로 가면 돼.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#058.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#059.src: I'm unsure if you can feel the light returning from the monolith, but I can. I almost feel reborn, with all this energy!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#059.dst: 모놀리스에서 빛이 돌아오는 게 너도 느껴지는지 모르겠지만, 난 느껴져. 이 힘에 다시 태어난 기분이야!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#059.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#060.src: The rift ahead ought to take us to the second monolith, but it doesn't seem to be working, and I'm unsure why.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#060.dst: 앞의 틈새가 두 번째 모놀리스로 데려다줘야 하는데, 작동을 안 해. 이유를 모르겠어.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#060.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#061.src: See? It's inert, which is... Odd. These aren't connected to the energy of the monolith.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#061.dst: 봤지? 멈춰 있어. 그건... 이상해. 이것들은 모놀리스의 힘과 연결돼 있지 않거든.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#061.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#062.src: It shouldn't be inactive as it is. There's some dark influence around here, but I can't seem to place it.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#062.dst: 이렇게 멈춰 있을 리가 없어. 근처에 어둠의 기운이 있는데 어딘지 모르겠어.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#062.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#063.src: My only guess is that it's interfering with the rift's energy. I've already scoured the hill though- No dark patches to be seen.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#063.dst: 내 추측으론 그게 틈새의 힘을 방해하는 것 같아. 그런데 언덕은 이미 샅샅이 뒤졌어- 어둠의 흔적은 없었어.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#063.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#064.src: Do you think you could take a second look-
The Realm of Light (Quest)#064.dst: 네가 한 번 더 살펴봐 줄 수-
The Realm of Light (Quest)#064.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#065.src: ...maybe you won't need to, after all. That was...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#065.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#068.src: We've found the disturbance... Even beyond this, I'll need to charge the rift with energy to activate it.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#068.dst: 원인을 찾았어... 그래도 틈새를 작동시키려면 힘을 채워 넣어야 해.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#068.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#069.src: Go in peace, tortured ones! Be at one with the light!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#069.dst: 편히 가렴, 고통받던 이들아! 빛과 하나가 되렴!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#069.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#070.src: Get the rest of them, {u}! I'll charge the rift!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#070.dst: 나머지를 맡아 줘, {u}! 난 틈새를 충전할게!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#070.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#071.src: Defeat the darkened creatures and progress to the monolith.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#071.dst: 어둠에 물든 생물들을 처치하고 모놀리스로 나아가세요.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#072.src: Thank you, achara. The rift is charged again- Just walk into it!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#072.dst: 고마워, achara. 틈새가 다시 충전됐어- 그냥 걸어 들어가면 돼!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#072.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#074.src: The process here should be roughly the same. I bring down the barrier, you enter and charge it with the light I provide.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#074.dst: 여기서도 절차는 거의 같아. 내가 장벽을 내리면 네가 들어가서 내가 준 빛으로 채우는 거야.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#074.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#075.src: I'll need to focus the energies of the monoliths to reconnect the Nexus of Light to the mainland here, so you'll be alone.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#075.dst: 넥서스를 이곳 본토에 다시 이으려면 모놀리스들의 힘을 모아야 해서, 이번엔 너 혼자 가야 해.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#075.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#076.src: I'll leave a barrier around you. Few creatures live on these cliffs, but best to be certain, of course.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#076.dst: 네 주위에 장벽을 쳐 둘게. 이 절벽엔 생물이 별로 없지만 확실히 해 두는 게 좋지.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#076.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#077.src: Once you're done, meet me at the cliff near the Nexus. If we're to free Orphion from the parasite, having you along would be a great help.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#077.dst: 끝나면 넥서스 근처 절벽에서 만나. Orphion을 기생체에게서 구하려면 네가 함께해 주는 게 큰 힘이 될 거야.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#077.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#078.src: Good luck, achara. I will see you soon.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#078.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#081.src: There. The connection to the Nexus is established, and so we'll cross.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#081.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#082.src: Wait! Something... Something's not quite right...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#082.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#084.src: Interfere?! You're one of the dark!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#084.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#085.src: You're the one trespassing in realms not your own!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#085.dst: 남의 영역을 침범한 건 바로 너야!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#085.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#086.src:
Lari:
{u}. I think. I found someone.
Who deserves to be killed. Help me out?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#086.dst:
Lari:
{u}. 있잖아. 누굴 찾았어.
죽어 마땅한 녀석을. 도와줄래?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#086.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#087.src: Continue up the road towards Orphion's Nexus of Light.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#087.dst: 오르피온의 빛의 넥서스를 향해 길을 따라 계속 올라가세요.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#088.src: {u}!! Stay back! I'm keeping up but he'll destroy you if you get close!!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#088.dst: {u}!! 물러나! 난 버티고 있지만 가까이 오면 저놈이 널 죽일 거야!!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#088.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#089.src: AGH, ENOUGH OF THIS! You aren't allowed here, foul thing!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#089.dst: 으아, 이제 그만! 넌 여기 있으면 안 돼, 더러운 것!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#089.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#091.src: No! You won't run- I'll kill you before that!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#091.dst: 안 돼! 도망 못 가- 그 전에 죽여주겠어!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#091.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#092.src: New Quest Started: Realm of Light V - The Realm of Light
The Realm of Light (Quest)#092.dst: 새 퀘스트 시작: 빛의 영역 V - 빛의 영역

The Realm of Light (Quest)#094.src: Or something that another person wants you to see?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#094.dst: 아니면 다른 누군가가 너에게 보여 주고 싶은 것?

The Realm of Light (Quest)#096.src: You. Elf girl. You are to be eliminated.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#096.dst: 너. 엘프 계집. 너는 제거 대상이다.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#097.src: Fool. The Beast quakes with our influence. This land is ours.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#097.dst: 어리석은 것. 짐승은 우리의 영향으로 떨고 있다. 이 땅은 우리의 것이다.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#098.src: I will not waste my time with that specimen. Now. Face death.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#098.dst: 그 표본에게 시간을 낭비하지 않겠다. 자. 죽음을 맞이해라.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#100.src: You shall not. Surely your god will smile seeing me leave.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#100.dst: 그럴 수 없을 것이다. 내가 떠나는 걸 보면 너의 신도 웃겠지.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#101.src: YOU DON'T GET TO TALK ABOUT ORPHION LIKE THAT!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#101.dst: 네가 감히 Orphion을 그렇게 말하지 마!

The Realm of Light (Quest)#102.src: We have already won. Your peon is outmatched.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#102.dst: 우리는 이미 이겼다. 너의 졸개는 상대가 되지 않는다.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#103.src: It's not over... IT CAN'T BE, DON'T YOU- TAKE THIS!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#103.dst: 아직 안 끝났어... 끝날 리 없어, 감히- 이거나 받아라!

The Realm of Light (Quest)#104.src: There's a faint buzzing in your ears...

The Realm of Light (Quest)#105.src: I have a slight idea of where I'm headed, but... If I'm able to handle him, then maybe I'm powerful enough for this.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#105.dst: 어디로 가는지 어렴풋이 알 것 같지만... 그 녀석을 상대할 수 있다면 이 정도는 감당할 만큼 강한 거겠지.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#106.src: I've never been one to say goodbyes, but thank you for everything. I know you'll find people just as strong as you are to rescue Orphion in my place.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#106.dst: 작별 인사는 잘 못 하지만, 전부 고마웠어. 너라면 나 대신 Orphion을 구할 만큼 강한 사람들을 찾을 거야.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#107.src: I- I see the end of this... Tunnel. There's- Wait...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#107.dst: 나- 이... 터널의 끝이 보여. 저기- 잠깐...

The Realm of Light (Quest)#109.src: {u}... Achara... I do not believe I can ever atone for what I have done to you. An apology simply isn't enough.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#109.dst: {u}... Achara... 내가 너한테 한 짓을 속죄할 수 있을 것 같지 않아. 사과로는 턱없이 부족해.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#110.src: You need to defeat the mob before you can progress!
